items.title: Was last night Pacome Dadiet's last, best chance?
items.author: Tommy Beer
items.body_excerpt:
Was last night Pacome Dadiet's last, best chance?

The Knicks have until October 31 to exercise Dadiet's $5.4 million option for the 2027-28 season, and it's becoming increasingly likely they will decline it.
